findings.summary: A missing/corrupt agent-dispatch-matrix.json could crash route-auditors or cause silent under-selection.
findings.mitigation: Matrix read in route-auditors mirrors the existing auditor-routing.json loader: existsSync + JSON.parse guarded, exit 2 with stderr on absence/parse error (fail-loud). The pure resolver in dispatch-matrix.ts is additive-only and never narrows below the tier floor (fail-safe).
